title: A whole city couldn't stop dancing (1518) #history #shorts
description: In July 1518, Frau Troffea began dancing in the streets of Strasbourg and couldn't stop. Others joined, up to about 400 by some accounts, and the city's cure was a stage and musicians. Sources: Britannica, Popular Science, History.com.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: In fifteen eighteen, an entire city started dancing, and nobody could stop.
scenes.title: A CITY THAT COULDN'T STOP DANCING

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: It began on July fourteenth in Strasbourg. A woman named Frau Troffea stepped into the street and danced. For days.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Then her neighbors started dancing too. By some accounts, as many as four hundred people joined in.

scenes.speaker: d
scenes.say: So what did the city leaders decide? The cure was... more dancing.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: They built a stage and hired musicians to keep everyone moving. It only made things worse.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Dancers collapsed from exhaustion. To this day, nobody knows for sure what caused it.

scenes.speaker: b
scenes.say: Would you have joined in, or run? Tell me in the comments.
